name: Frequency protection
summary: A function responding to a documented frequency condition.
description: Frequency protection responds to frequency conditions according to the selected implementation. Underfrequency, overfrequency and rate-of-change functions can be distinguished by additional suffixes and device documentation. A generic 81 reference does not determine which variant is applied.

On a power drawing, keep this function reference connected to the selected equipment and its complete designation. A multifunction relay can implement several numbered functions. This entry explains the reference; it supplies no settings or commissioning procedure.
readingNotes: Read the complete designation, not only the base number.
Identify the voltage or other input from which the selected device derives its frequency measurement.
drawingChecklist: Link any trip, alarm or load-control action.
distinction: Underfrequency, overfrequency and rate-of-change are different functions even when their designations share the number 81.
